title: Drawing Progress
reason: Build 7 Draw Progress; no new slot.
specification: Reveal or hide a stroke along its measured length. Controls: Start Trim, End Trim, Offset, Reverse. Preserve brush width, caps and path direction; glow sees only the revealed segment.

title: Recorded Brush Replay
reason: Art Studio needs saved stroke events; DrawingDoc currently saves raster layers.
specification: Reconstruct newly recorded Art Studio painting in its original order, including pressure and erasing. Controls: progress, playback rate, pause compression. Requires saved stroke events; old flattened PNGs cannot recover this history.

title: Sequential Stroke Build
reason: Review Art Studio multi-stroke ordering and path ownership; not a second basic progress effect.
specification: Finish one path before beginning the next. Controls: progress, ordering, inter-stroke delay, length-weighted timing. Compare against Drawing Progress's modes before approving a separate catalog entry.

title: Stroke Growth from Seeds
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Grow visible segments outward from selected points on a path. Controls: seed positions, growth distance, overlap merging. Multiple seeds can reveal branches simultaneously.

title: Moving Stroke Window
reason: Existing ShapeStroke trimStart/trimEnd/trimOffset animate a moving window.
specification: Move a finite visible section along a path, like a traveling highlight. Controls: head position, tail length, taper. If Drawing Progress already covers this completely, keep it as a preset instead.

title: Variable Width Profile
reason: Compare raster pressure/taper with vector width profiles; extend stroke model where missing.
specification: Shape stroke thickness with an editable curve along its length. Controls: profile, minimum width, pressure blend. Tapers should remain smooth when the path is resampled.

title: Animated Dash Flow
reason: Dash sequences belong in shape stroke geometry; check trims and caps.
specification: Move a configurable dash-and-gap pattern along a stroke. Controls: dash sequence, phase, cap shape, fit-to-length. Dashes follow actual distance rather than vertex spacing.

title: Brush Stamp Along Path
reason: Review brush stamps and path tools before approving a separate effect.
specification: Place a chosen image repeatedly along a path. Controls: distance, tangent alignment, scale, seeded variation. Useful for leaves, stitches and decorative borders.

title: Calligraphic Nib
reason: Flat Chisel already exists; inspect nib orientation/pressure gap.
specification: Change apparent stroke width according to its direction relative to a tilted nib. Controls: nib angle, aspect ratio, pressure influence. This generates geometry rather than merely rotating a texture.

title: Brush Bristle Separation
reason: Art Studio brush model, not a renamed paint filter.
specification: Split a recorded stroke into fine parallel bristle traces. Controls: bristle count, spread, ink loading, seed. Keep the traces tied to the stroke's local frame.

title: Stroke Junction Welding
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Join intersecting stroke outlines into clean continuous shapes. Controls: weld distance, corner handling, hole preservation. Avoid dark overlaps and gaps at crossings.

title: Stroke to Ribbon
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Turn a centerline into a shaded ribbon with independently controlled width and twist. Controls: width profile, twist, edge lighting. It must handle tight bends without exploding geometry.

title: Path Envelope Deform
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Bend artwork inside two editable boundary curves. Controls: upper/lower guides, mapping resolution, pinning. Unlike point displacement, the guides define the entire deformation region.

title: Path Attractor
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Pull path vertices toward a target curve with distance-based falloff. Controls: guide, strength, radius, preserve length. Useful for organizing loose lines around a silhouette.

title: Curvature Smooth
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Remove unwanted bumps while protecting deliberate corners. Controls: smoothing scale, iterations, corner threshold. Operate on curve shape rather than blurring its rendered pixels.

title: Length-Preserving Path Relax
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Even out kinks while resisting changes in total path length. Controls: relaxation, stiffness, pinned endpoints. Useful for animated ropes and drawn gestures.

title: Contour Resample
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Redistribute path samples by arc length or curvature. Controls: spacing, curvature density, corner preservation. Primarily a technical operation; expose as a tool if no useful animatable effect remains.

title: Path Boolean Combine
reason: Vector geometry/boolean tooling; compare mask add/subtract/intersect first.
specification: Union, intersect, subtract or XOR selected vector contours. Controls: operand layers, operation, tolerance. Check existing shape operations; count once for all boolean modes.

title: Skeleton Stroke
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Derive centerlines from a filled silhouette. Controls: minimum branch length, smoothing, width recovery. Useful for turning bold artwork into editable line structures.

title: Contour Correspondence Morph
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Morph between two matched paths. Controls: target, progress, landmark pairs, winding. Resolve point correspondence explicitly rather than crossfading two images.

title: Shape Medial Inflation
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Expand a silhouette according to its internal thickness, preserving narrow features differently from broad regions. Controls: inflation, thickness weighting, boundary smoothing.

title: Silhouette Bridge
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Create controllable vector connections between nearby shapes. Controls: gap distance, bridge width, neck curvature. The result is actual connecting geometry.

title: Path Weave
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Alternate which crossing stroke appears above or below. Controls: weave pattern, crossing clearance, gap softness. Determine crossings from geometry, not an arbitrary screen checkerboard.

title: Stroke Knot Reveal
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reveal intersecting paths while preserving the chosen crossing order. Controls: reveal position, crossing order, overlap clearance. Reject as a separate effect if Path Weave plus Drawing Progress fully covers it.

title: Contour Travel Markers
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Move generated markers along a path at uniform distance or time intervals. Controls: marker shape, spacing, progress, tangent orientation. Preserve stable marker identities while animating.

title: Copy Background
reason: Adjustment and Displacement Map Layers Below already process scene content. Prove any missing copy input before adding.
specification: Copy the composited layers below into this layer's region for further processing. Controls: sampling space, bounds, opacity. It is a true scene input, not another duplicate image file.

title: Difference Matte
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Compare footage with a clean background plate to isolate changed areas. Controls: reference frame/layer, tolerance, softness, despill. Camera alignment and noise strongly affect results.

title: Clean Plate Builder
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Estimate an unobstructed background from multiple frames. Controls: time range, motion exclusion, statistic, quality. Requires temporal analysis and cancellable baking.

title: Alpha Distance Field
reason: No signed-distance data output found in inspected alpha/choke/outline controls; needs measured-distance implementation.
specification: Convert transparency into signed distance from the silhouette edge. Controls: distance range, inside/outside display, precision. This is a reusable mask output for downstream effects.

title: Distance Bands
reason: Existing luma contours are not alpha-distance contour bands; reuse the distance foundation.
specification: Generate evenly spaced bands around a silhouette. Controls: spacing, band width, phase, inside/outside. Unlike a decorative outline preset, bands use real edge distance.

title: Variable Distance Outline
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Expand or contract a silhouette with width driven by another image. Controls: width map, range, direction, smoothing. Audit against existing Border and Minimax before acceptance.

title: Matte Hole Fill
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Fill enclosed holes below a chosen size without expanding the external boundary. Controls: hole area, connectivity, feather. Preserve intentionally large openings.

title: Matte Island Filter
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Remove isolated connected mask regions by area or selected component. Controls: minimum area, largest-only, connectivity. Useful for cleaning speckled keys.

title: Matte Topology Guard
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Clean a mask while resisting accidental merging of separate regions or closure of important holes. Controls: cleanup radius, topology protection, strength.

title: Temporal Matte Stabilizer
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reduce frame-to-frame mask chatter using motion-aligned history. Controls: history, responsiveness, motion rejection. A static blur cannot substitute for temporal stability.

title: Motion-Aware Edge Fill
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reconstruct thin missing edges from neighboring frames after motion alignment. Controls: search range, confidence, edge width. Require rejection of unreliable motion.

title: Foreground Color Recovery
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Estimate foreground colors at translucent keyed edges. Controls: background color/plate, recovery strength, edge region. Separate color recovery from merely shrinking alpha.

title: Alpha-Aware Decontamination
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Remove background contamination using nearby solid foreground colors. Controls: sample radius, edge width, strength. Audit existing Remove Color Matting and Edge Refine first.

title: Matte Frequency Split
reason: Independent alpha base/detail recombination is not provided by current alpha levels/choke/feather.
specification: Separate broad silhouette structure from fine details such as hair. Controls: separation scale, detail gain, base gain. Recombine without making alpha values invalid.

title: Channel Route
reason: RGB Channel Mixer exists; extend alpha/constants routing only if absent.
specification: Route any input channel into any output channel, including alpha and constants. Controls: source per output, inversion, premultiplication. Existing Channel Mixer overlap requires a gap check.

title: Channel Math
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Apply selected arithmetic operations between channels from two sources. Controls: channel pair, operation, scale, clamp. One effect covers its arithmetic modes.

title: Alpha Premultiplication Repair
reason: Integrate alpha interpretation with import/compositor; do not expose unsafe redundant conversion blindly.
specification: Correct mismatched straight/premultiplied input interpretation. Controls: input convention, output convention, edge handling. Expose as a repair utility rather than an artistic look.

title: Luminance-Preserving Composite
reason: Compare Color/Luminosity blend modes; do not count their existing behavior again.
specification: Blend color from one source while constraining luminance changes. Controls: blend amount, luminance reference, gamut limit. Compare against existing luminosity/color blend modes.

title: Local Contrast Matte
reason: Current absolute color/luma selection does not expose neighborhood-relative contrast selection.
specification: Select details by contrast against their local neighborhood. Controls: radius, contrast range, polarity, softness. This differs from selecting absolute brightness.

title: Texture Similarity Matte
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Select regions resembling a reference texture patch. Controls: reference patch, feature scale, tolerance, cleanup. Preview matching confidence before applying alpha.

title: Depth Range Matte
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Select a near/far interval from a supplied depth map. Controls: near, far, feather, depth convention. Do not imply ordinary photos contain measured depth automatically.

title: Normal Direction Matte
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Select surfaces facing a chosen direction from a normal map. Controls: direction, angular range, softness. Useful for selective lighting and material masks.

title: Object ID Matte
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Select explicit object/material IDs from a supplied ID image. Controls: selected IDs, tolerance, edge treatment. Genuine support requires stable IDs and defined anti-aliasing behavior.

title: Guided Matte Upscale
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Upscale a low-resolution mask using image edges as guidance. Controls: guidance layer, edge strength, radius. Preserve fine boundaries without simply sharpening the mask.

title: Occlusion Composite
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Use explicit depth maps to decide which of two layers is in front per pixel. Controls: depth sources, bias, softness. It cannot infer reliable 3D occlusion from Z sorting alone.

title: Edge-Derived Rays
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Emit rays from detected contours instead of all bright pixels. Controls: edge scale, source point, ray length, falloff. Compare against existing Shine and God Rays.

title: Diffraction Aperture
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Spread bright points according to an aperture shape's diffraction pattern. Controls: aperture, blade count, rotation, wavelength spread. It must differ from fixed star streaks.

title: Spectral Prism Dispersion
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Refract multiple wavelength bands through a configurable prism field. Controls: prism angle, dispersion, thickness. More than independent RGB position offsets.

title: Thin-Film Interference
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Create view/thickness-dependent interference colors on a supplied surface field. Controls: film thickness, index, angle map, roughness. Compare existing Holographic Foil.

title: Caustic Projector
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Project concentrated light patterns produced by a configurable refractive surface. Controls: surface field, light direction, focus, animation. Avoid relabeling generic noise as caustics.

title: Light-Field Occlusion Rays
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Attenuate rays using an explicit occluder layer. Controls: source, occluder, sampling quality, softness. Occlusion must change the light path.

title: Anamorphic Flare Ghosts
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Generate linked lens ghosts and directional flare response from tracked highlights. Controls: lens layout, squeeze, coatings, threshold. Audit existing Lens Flare modes.

title: Lens Ghost Model
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Place internal reflection images according to a configurable lens element layout. Controls: element positions, reflectance, aperture mask. Combine with entry 57 if the implementations coincide.

title: Sensor Microlens Bloom
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Model highlight charge spreading with directional sensor behavior. Controls: saturation threshold, spill direction, radius, recovery. Differentiate from existing Glow before counting.

title: Rolling Shutter Exposure
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Integrate motion at different times for different image rows. Controls: scan duration, direction, shutter angle. Requires time samples, not a static slant warp.

title: Chromatic Focus Shift
reason: Channel Blur/Lens Blur already exist; depth-dependent focal offsets are the gap, not channel blur itself.
specification: Blur wavelength bands according to distinct focus distances. Controls: focus map, channel focal offsets, aperture. This is focus-dependent blur rather than RGB Split.

title: Cat-Eye Bokeh
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Shape out-of-focus highlights differently toward frame edges. Controls: aperture, optical vignetting, depth/focus map. Extend existing Bokeh if it already supports this behavior.

title: Split Diopter
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Simulate two independently focused image regions with a transition boundary. Controls: regions, focus distances, aperture, seam softness. Requires a depth map for convincing focus behavior.

title: Tilted Focal Plane
reason: Compare existing Tilt Shift and Lens Blur before adding another focus effect.
specification: Compute focus from a tilted plane and supplied depth. Controls: plane angle, distance, aperture. A geometric focal plane differs from a simple Tilt-Shift blur band.

title: Lens Breathing
reason: Camera focus/zoom behavior belongs in camera/lens controls.
specification: Change image magnification and optical center as focus changes. Controls: focus animation, breathing curve, center shift. Match blur changes only when focus inputs are available.

title: Anisotropic Surface Reflection
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Shade supplied normals with directionally stretched highlights. Controls: tangent direction, roughness axes, light. Compare existing specular/material effects.

title: Subsurface Light Spread
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Spread incident light through a thickness map, preserving a sharper surface component. Controls: thickness, scattering color, radius. Do not present a single tinted blur as full subsurface simulation.

title: Transmission Shadow Color
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Tint projected shadows using a translucent occluder's color and alpha. Controls: light, projection, absorption, softness. Needs explicit receiver and occluder inputs.

title: Contact Light Spill
reason: Light Wrap exists. Review actual background sampling rather than adding another name.
specification: Restrict light spill to the gap between nearby source and receiver silhouettes. Controls: source, receiver, distance falloff. Differentiate from existing Light Wrap.

title: Polarization Response
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Attenuate highlights according to orientation from supplied reflection/normal data. Controls: filter angle, polarization strength, surface selection. Without those inputs, label the result an approximation.

title: Spectral Absorption
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Attenuate wavelength bands according to a thickness map. Controls: absorption spectrum/preset, thickness, density. Useful for colored glass and liquids.

title: Optical Vignetting Map
reason: Vignette exists; data-map output/model variants should be modes where appropriate.
specification: Generate aperture-dependent falloff from lens geometry and view position. Controls: aperture, pupil offset, projection. Reject as new if existing Vignette fully covers the intended result.

title: Depth Fog Integration
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Accumulate colored scattering through supplied depth. Controls: density, height, falloff, light direction. Differentiate from the existing Clouds & Fog generator.

title: Relight from Normal and Depth
reason: Normal Map Lighting and 3D lights exist; inspect normal/depth input support first.
specification: Apply controllable lights to supplied normal/depth inputs. Controls: light type, position, color, shadow approximation. Ordinary image luminance is not a substitute for real normals.

title: Environment Reflection Lookup
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reflect an environment image using surface normals and a view model. Controls: environment, roughness, orientation, Fresnel. Compare existing Glass Material and Chrome Metal.

title: Vector Field Advection
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Carry pixels through a supplied velocity field for a chosen integration time. Controls: field, strength, steps, boundary mode. Temporal accumulation is optional and explicitly separate.

title: Curl Field Warp
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Generate swirling displacement from a divergence-free curl field. Controls: scale, strength, seed, evolution. Audit existing Fractal Warp and Liquid Warp first.

title: Reaction-Diffusion Warp
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Use a baked reaction-diffusion simulation as the displacement field. Controls: feed, kill, diffusion, simulation time. Deterministic playback requires cached simulation states.

title: Harmonic Cage Warp
reason: Inspect Puppet Pins and path handles before adding a cage solver.
specification: Deform artwork from an enclosing editable cage with smooth interior interpolation. Controls: cage points, influence, quality. Compare existing Puppet Pins.

title: Rigid Region Deform
reason: ARAP-style rigid regions must improve Puppet/rig deformation, not duplicate pin UI.
specification: Preserve selected rigid patches while deforming the surrounding image. Controls: pins, rigid regions, stiffness. Requires a constrained solver, not ordinary mesh interpolation.

title: Content-Aware Retarget
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Resize while protecting important image regions. Controls: target size, protection/removal masks, quality. Bake expensive analysis; avoid promising perfect reconstruction.

title: Seam Insertion Stretch
reason: Merge with #81 content-aware resizing if one seam-carving engine handles insertion/removal.
specification: Expand an image through computed low-cost seams rather than uniform scaling. Controls: seam direction, count, energy map. Combine with entry 81 if implemented as its resize mode.

title: Conformal Region Warp
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Deform a region while minimizing local angle changes. Controls: boundary handles, constraints, solver quality. Useful for bending graphic elements without severe local skew.

title: Perspective Surface Reproject
reason: Compare Corner Pin/homography source-target mapping; do not rename an equivalent mapping.
specification: Map a source between calibrated planar camera views. Controls: source/target corners or cameras, crop, filtering. Existing Corner Pin may make this a tool rather than a new effect.

title: Depth Reprojection
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reproject an image using supplied depth and a virtual camera movement. Controls: depth scale, camera, hole-fill policy. Newly exposed areas require explicit reconstruction or transparency.

title: Stereo Disparity Shift
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Produce or adjust a stereo view from a disparity map. Controls: convergence, separation, eye, hole handling. Does not create reliable stereo depth from no input data.

title: Equirectangular View Extract
reason: Inspect existing Sphere Map/Skybox projection math and camera controls.
specification: Render a perspective view from a 360-degree image. Controls: yaw, pitch, roll, field of view. Compare current Sphere Map and Skybox behavior.

title: Projection Converter
reason: Audit projection modes as one family, not a new entry for each conversion.
specification: Convert between supported spherical, cylindrical, cubemap and fisheye projections. Controls: input/output projection, orientation, coverage. Count projection modes once.

title: Lens Calibration Warp
reason: Lens Distortion already has K1/K2, chromatic fringe, zoom and center. Tangential terms/inversion should extend it.
specification: Apply or undo calibrated radial and tangential distortion coefficients. Controls: calibration coefficients, optical center, inverse mode. Existing Lens Distortion must be audited first.

title: Mesh UV Distortion
reason: Displacement Map already reads RG; distinguish absolute UV remap from relative displacement before approval.
specification: Sample an image with a supplied UV-coordinate map. Controls: UV source, channel layout, wrap, filtering. Useful for authored surfaces and reusable deformation maps.

title: Flow Map Painter
reason: Painted vector assets belong in Art Studio and feed displacement; requires vector-field storage.
specification: Paint directional vectors that drive local distortion. Controls: field brush, strength, integration, smoothing. Requires an editable vector field asset and a clear bake workflow.

title: Distance-Gradient Warp
reason: Self-silhouette distance-gradient displacement is absent from current reference-image Displacement Map.
specification: Move pixels along the gradient of a silhouette distance field. Controls: source matte, displacement, falloff, sign. Creates contour-following deformation rather than radial bulging.

title: Voronoi Cell Reassemble
reason: Voronoi Shatter/Crystallize already exist; inspect cell transform controls before adding.
specification: Split an image into stable Voronoi cells and move each cell independently. Controls: seeds, transform field, gaps, seed. Compare existing Shatter and Crystallize.

title: Topology-Preserving Melt
reason: Plastic soft materials already exist; topology constraints belong in Physics Studio.
specification: Deform a silhouette with constraints that resist tearing or unwanted merging. Controls: gravity, viscosity approximation, anchors, duration. Requires mesh/field constraints and may need baking.

title: Directional Compression Field
reason: Compare Stretch Segment, Squeeze and RG Displacement Map before accepting.
specification: Compress image regions according to a painted or supplied field. Controls: direction map, compression, protected areas. Compare Stretch Segment and Squeeze.

title: Elastic Sheet Solver
reason: Elastic simulation/pins belong in Physics Studio; no noise-warp substitute.
specification: Treat the layer as an elastic sheet with pins and forces. Controls: stiffness, damping, force field, pin mask. Audit Physics Studio overlap before assigning an effect slot.

title: Shock Refraction Field
reason: Compare Ripple/Shockwave plus backdrop displacement and proposed distance bands.
specification: Refract the background through a moving, thickness-defined shock front. Controls: front path, width, refractive strength, dispersion. Differentiate from a simple Shockwave Ring generator.

title: Gradient-Domain Warp Repair
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Blend seams created by a warp using a gradient-domain reconstruction. Controls: repair mask, boundary source, solver quality. This is a compositing repair stage, not another warp shape.

title: Barycentric Triangle Morph
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Morph matched triangulations between source and target landmarks. Controls: landmark pairs, progress, triangle constraints. Preserve correct texture correspondence across triangles.

title: Folded Surface Refraction
reason: Compare Page Curl/Accordion Fold; transparent refraction is a material extension.
specification: Refract an underlying image through a user-defined folded transparent sheet. Controls: crease paths, fold angle, thickness, index. Compare Page Curl and Accordion Fold to avoid duplication.

title: Anisotropic Kuwahara
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Smooth within locally oriented regions while retaining strong boundaries. Controls: radius, anisotropy, sector weighting. Audit Oil Paint's underlying filter before adding.

title: Flow-Guided Line Extraction
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Detect and connect lines along a smoothed image orientation field. Controls: flow scale, edge threshold, continuity. Compare current Find Edges and Cartoon Outline.

title: Coherent Line Hatching
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Lay strokes along the image's local structure rather than fixed screen angles. Controls: density, tone response, flow smoothing. Distinguish from existing Cross Hatch.

title: Engraving Plate Simulation
reason: Compare Woodcut, line screens and emboss before approving physical plate behavior.
specification: Convert tone into etched grooves with relief and ink retention. Controls: groove profile, spacing, pressure, paper. Compare Woodcut and Halftone Lines.

title: Lithographic Grain Transfer
reason: Risograph/Screen Print already exist; establish a pressure/plate transfer gap.
specification: Simulate grease/pigment pickup from a textured plate. Controls: plate texture, ink density, pressure, tone threshold. Compare existing Risograph and Screen Print.

title: Mezzotint Scrape
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Form lighter areas by removing marks from a dense dark texture. Controls: scrape radius, grain density, tonal response. Preserve the subtractive process rather than applying generic noise.

title: Drypoint Burr Ink
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Add soft ink accumulation beside etched line grooves. Controls: burr width, ink amount, line source. Differentiate from ordinary blur or Ink Bleed.

title: Monotype Transfer
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Transfer uneven paint from a plate with pressure and residual pigment. Controls: plate texture, pressure map, lift, residual amount. A second pull should differ predictably if history is enabled.

title: Gouache Coverage
reason: Oil Paint and Watercolor already exist; deposition must differ algorithmically.
specification: Approximate opaque pigment deposition with thickness and edge texture. Controls: coverage, thickness, dry brush, surface. Compare existing Oil Paint and Watercolor.

title: Granulating Pigment
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Settle pigment into low parts of a paper-height map. Controls: grain size, settling, pigment separation, paper. Differentiate from simply overlaying paper noise.

title: Wet-Pigment Separation
reason: Pigment diffusion requires Art Studio simulation state and reproducible baking.
specification: Separate multiple pigment components according to different diffusion rates. Controls: pigment palette, wetness, diffusion, duration. Simulation requires deterministic baking.

title: Backrun Bloom Simulation
reason: Actual wet backruns require simulation; current Ink Bleed is not proof of that capability.
specification: Create watercolor backruns as a wetter region pushes pigment into an edge. Controls: wetness source, timing, diffusion, drying. Compare existing Ink Bleed's behavior.

title: Scratchboard Removal
reason: Authored scratches/eraser/layers already reveal a substrate; identify missing material behavior first.
specification: Reveal a light substrate by scraping a dark coating along paths. Controls: scratch paths, width, pressure, substrate. Requires stroke geometry or recorded input.

title: Sgraffito Layers
reason: Multi-coating scratch depth belongs with Art Studio layers/erasing.
specification: Scratch through stacked color coatings to reveal lower layers. Controls: coating stack, scratch depth, paths, roughness. Differentiate from a single alpha erase.

title: Needle-Felt Texture Synthesis
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Construct oriented fibers whose packing follows tone and direction. Controls: fiber length, direction field, density, depth shading. Avoid static texture overlays as the entire implementation.

title: Thread Embroidery
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Fill regions with discrete stitches following a direction field. Controls: stitch length, density, border, thread relief. Count stitch patterns as modes, not separate effects.

title: Woven Image Reconstruction
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Rebuild an image using interlaced colored warp and weft threads. Controls: weave pattern, yarn width, palette, lighting. Geometry/occlusion must reflect crossings.

title: Mosaic Grout Solver
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Fit irregular tiles to contours and fill their gaps with grout. Controls: tile size, contour following, grout, material. Compare existing Mosaic Tiles and Crystallize.

title: Vector Region Simplify
reason: Editable vector output requires path assets and simplification tooling.
specification: Convert image regions into simplified editable filled contours. Controls: palette, contour tolerance, small-region merge. This needs vector output support, not merely a flattened preview.

title: Palette Error-Diffusion Mapper
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Quantize to a user palette while distributing color error spatially. Controls: palette, diffusion method, strength, serpentine scan. Compare existing Retro Dither and Pixel Art modes.

title: Motion-Compensated Temporal Denoise
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Align neighboring frames before averaging noise. Controls: history, motion confidence, detail retention. Reject ghosting near occlusions.

title: Temporal Median Cleanup
reason: Median is percentile 50; merge with #123 instead of counting twice.
specification: Replace short-lived outliers using the median across a time window. Controls: window, motion compensation, rejection mask. Useful for transient speckles and flashes.

title: Temporal Percentile Composite
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Select a configurable temporal brightness percentile per pixel. Controls: window, percentile, channel, motion alignment. Median/min/max are modes within this effect.

title: Motion Vector Display
reason: Existing optical-flow pipeline needs a diagnostic/data-output mode, not a second estimator.
specification: Visualize actual estimated or supplied motion vectors. Controls: vector source, scale, color encoding, grid. A useful diagnostic and data output for later effects.

title: Motion Vector Remap
reason: Integrate signed motion-vector mapping with existing Displacement Map/reference inputs.
specification: Modify motion vectors before a reconstruction stage. Controls: scale, rotation, threshold, region mask. Existing optical-flow interpolation must be checked for overlap.

title: Motion-Compensated Frame Interpolation
reason: SlowMotion.swift already invokes optical-flow interpolation; do not add another Twixtor wrapper.
specification: Synthesize intermediate frames using forward/backward flow and occlusion handling. Controls: interpolation time, quality, confidence. Audit Twixtor/Time Remap first; improve them instead if already supported.

title: Temporal Slice Scan
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Sample different times along a configurable spatial scan. Controls: time span, scan curve, direction, boundary policy. Different from a single-frame Scan Distort.

title: Temporal Depth Scan
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Choose sample time using a depth map. Controls: depth/time mapping, range, interpolation. Requires valid depth and temporal source frames.

title: Temporal Texture Advection
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Move an applied texture along scene motion over time. Controls: texture, flow source, persistence, reinitialization. Resist slipping and handle newly visible surfaces.

title: Motion-Tracked Paint Accumulation
reason: Tracking plus recorded paint accumulation must extend tracking/Art Studio state.
specification: Accumulate paint in tracked scene space. Controls: motion source, deposition, decay, confidence. This must follow the object rather than the screen.

title: Long Exposure Integrator
reason: Echo/time sampling exists; extend integration/averaging where genuinely absent.
specification: Integrate actual frames over a shutter interval. Controls: duration, weighting, exposure normalization, sample count. Compare existing Echo and motion-blur tools.

title: Selective Motion Freeze
reason: Freeze plus masks/layer compositing exists; any automatic motion selection is a workflow extension.
specification: Freeze regions with little motion while preserving moving areas, or the reverse. Controls: motion threshold, reference time, feather. Motion classification must be temporally stable.

title: Temporal Background Hold
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Keep a reference background while updating selected moving foreground. Controls: clean plate, motion mask, update rate. Handle camera motion explicitly.

title: Motion Cadence Converter
reason: Cadence conversion belongs in media/timeline/export, not a visual filter name.
specification: Resample footage into a deliberate exposure cadence with frame holds or blends. Controls: cadence pattern, phase, blending. Compare Posterize Time; count only a real missing cadence feature.

title: Field Order Repair
reason: Interlaced repair belongs in media decoding/repair.
specification: Detect or explicitly correct interlaced field ordering and reconstruct progressive frames. Controls: field order, deinterlace method, motion threshold. Keep original timing correct.

title: Duplicate Frame Repair
reason: Analyze duplicate frames and reuse interpolation; not an extra generic blur.
specification: Detect repeated frames and reconstruct or retime the affected interval. Controls: detection threshold, repair strategy, range. Never silently alter clip duration.

title: Flash Exposure Equalizer
reason: Brightness analysis should drive existing Exposure keyframes.
specification: Detect short exposure spikes and balance them against nearby frames. Controls: detection, correction strength, protected flashes. Expose detected events for review.

title: Temporal Color Stabilizer
reason: Temporal color analysis should drive CC Studio rather than duplicate grading.
specification: Reduce unwanted color-temperature and exposure drift while preserving intended changes. Controls: analysis range, smoothing, reference, exclusion mask. Bake analysis separately from rendering.

title: Occlusion-Aware Motion Trails
reason: Echo already exists; occlusion-aware flow is an advanced time mode.
specification: Accumulate moving subjects while respecting foreground occluders. Controls: trail duration, spacing, depth/matte input, decay. Ordinary Echo without occlusion does not qualify.

title: Flow-Aligned Motion Texture
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Stretch procedural texture along measured motion paths. Controls: flow, length, density, lifespan. Compare existing Wind Streaks and Light Trails for a genuine gap.

title: Flow Morph Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Warp matched A/B content toward an intermediate image before blending. Controls: progress, correspondences, flow quality, occlusion. Unrelated shots may require manual landmarks.

title: Depth Portal Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Move through a masked opening while A/B layers are placed at supplied depths. Controls: portal matte, depth, camera path, edge treatment. It must composite both sources correctly.

title: Distance-Matte Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reveal B according to distance from an arbitrary matte boundary. Controls: seed matte, progress, band width, edge shading. Differentiate from simple linear/radial wipes.

title: Object-Matched Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Align a selected object in A with a selected object in B and transition around it. Controls: landmarks/tracks, alignment, progress, background treatment. This needs correspondence data.

title: Motion-Continuation Cut
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Match incoming movement to outgoing motion around the cut. Controls: tracked direction, velocity matching, blend interval, crop. Expose correction strength rather than promising automatic perfect cuts.

title: Luminance-Ordered A/B Reveal
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Reveal B using a brightness ordering derived from A or a supplied map. Controls: map source, threshold progression, feather, preservation. Audit existing Luma Key plus transitions for overlap.

title: Frequency-Separated Dissolve
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Transition broad structure and fine detail at different rates. Controls: separation scale, phase offset, progress. The decomposition must be real, not two opacity presets.

title: Gradient-Domain A/B Blend
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Blend images by reconstructing their gradients across a transition boundary. Controls: boundary, progress, solver quality, color anchoring. Requires explicit boundary conditions.

title: Shared-Edge Peel Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Peel A away along a guide to reveal B beneath it with consistent contact shadow. Controls: guide, curl radius, progress, lighting. Audit Page Curl and use a transition mode if sufficient.

title: Volume Slice Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Treat A/B and intermediate samples as a time volume, then reveal a moving slice. Controls: slice orientation, thickness, progress, interpolation. Requires defined intermediate data.

title: Tracked Surface Replacement Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Introduce B on a tracked plane in A and expand to the new shot. Controls: planar track, expansion, perspective, timing. Reuse existing tracking rather than duplicating it.

title: Particle Correspondence Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Sample A/B into particles with stable matched identities and animate between them. Controls: particle spacing, correspondence, trajectory, progress. Audit existing particle morph capabilities.

title: Silhouette Interlock Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Grow complementary boundaries from A/B mattes until the new shot fills the frame. Controls: mattes, growth ordering, gap, progress. Require consistent coverage with no unintended transparent cracks.

title: Seam-Optimized Transition
reason: Compare implementation and controls with existing owner before accepting.
specification: Move a low-visibility seam through A/B according to image differences. Controls: progress, seam cost, protected regions, softness. Bake optimization when needed.

title: Audio-Driven Transition Timing
reason: Audio/beat timing should drive real transition progress; not a separate visual effect.
specification: Drive an actual chosen A/B transition's progress with a user-approved beat/envelope curve. Controls: analysis source, event selection, easing, manual override. This may belong as a transition timing controller rather than a counted visual effect.
